semiconductor_relevance: High — UNI Semiconductor Corporation is a key supplier of photomasks, which are critical components in the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: UNI Semiconductor Corporation is a specialized manufacturer of photomasks, focusing on mature semiconductor processes with technology nodes ranging from 180nm to 22nm. The company offers a variety of photomask products, including Binary Image Masks, KrF Phase Shift Masks, ArF PSM, and Optical Mask Optimization Group masks, catering to high-end and mid-range market needs.
capabilities: Production of KrF Phase Shift Masks (PSM)
Development of ArF Phase Shift Masks
